chapters.content:
A Good Girl's Guide to Murder is a contemporary work by Holly Jackson (2019).

High-school senior Pip Fitz-Amobi re-examines a closed local murder-suicide case for her senior project, uncovering dangerous town secrets.

Categorized under: Mystery, YA, Detective Fiction.
